tolerance_origin: Explicit project accuracy budget fixed before N128 completion. Not universal thresholds from the cited papers. Existing pre-AH baryon and AH-solver limits are retained; all new accuracy budgets are stated here and versioned. V2 retains every V1 numerical budget unchanged; the additional min=max=1 checks require documented evidence, not new percentage tolerances from the reviewer.

physical_setup_verified.meaning: EOS, units, perturbations, initial-data hash, gauge and physical mesh hierarchy are recorded and verified.

target_completed.meaning: Full originally requested physical target, not merely an allocated probe.

AH_scaled_residual_max.meaning: Finder quality prerequisite; not physical validation by itself.

exterior_H_M2_rms.meaning: Proper-volume RMS H times initial ADM mass squared; agreed common exterior region, excluding mask/AH interiors.

exterior_M_M2_rms.meaning: Proper-volume RMS metric-contracted momentum constraint times initial ADM mass squared.

mass_energy_balance_relative_residual.meaning: Consistent asymptotic ADM/Bondi or controlled finite-worldtube energy balance. Include measured outgoing radiation and matter/EM flux; missing terms cannot be zero-filled.

boundary_mass_relative_change.meaning: Matched inner resolution, doubled outer-boundary control, same physical mass window.

grid_convergence_evidence_complete.meaning: At least three matched actual grid spacings with same physical target; provide observed order and uncertainties or a justified nonasymptotic error envelope. For BBH include waveform, merger time, remnant mass/spin; for matter include density, collapse time, remnant and exterior constraints. Missing convergence evidence cannot pass.

mature_code_direct_comparison_complete.meaning: Direct quantitative comparison against a genuinely matched mature-code trajectory, with input/source hashes, observable conventions, reference uncertainties and relative/appropriate absolute errors. Similar phenomena, an unexecuted comparison script, or the same event name alone are insufficient.

error_budget_separated.meaning: Distinguish evolution/grid/time/AMR, initial-data and relaxation, AH geometry, extraction and boundary errors as applicable; identify an unresolved discrepancy instead of attributing it without evidence.

remnant_mass_relative_uncertainty.meaning: Three matched resolutions and positive observed order; finest Richardson mass error <=1%.

remnant_mass_tail_relative_range.meaning: Common late-time horizon-mass window; residual accretion must be resolved or reported.

remnant_dimensionless_spin_abs_max.meaning: Nonrotating initial data: abs(J_AH)/M_Christodoulou^2, not the dimensional spin field.

collapse_detection_relative_uncertainty.meaning: Resolution plus first-reliable-AH detection cadence uncertainty; same gauge and units. Not an exact universal collapse time.

exterior_constraint_observed_order.meaning: Matched common exterior region, three resolutions; first-order shock-limited convergence allowed. No fourth-order assumption.

initial_TOV_mass_relative_error.meaning: Compare unperturbed progenitor TOV mass with an independent high-accuracy ODE solution.

initial_TOV_areal_radius_relative_error.meaning: Areal, not isotropic, stellar radius against independent TOV ODE.

pre_AH_baryon_relative_drift.meaning: Existing collapse protocol limit before first reliable AH; perturbations, boundary flux and any source corrections documented.

post_AH_baryon_balance_verified.meaning: Explain the reported post-AH drift and close a defined physical-exterior baryon budget with moving inner-boundary flux, outer flux and accumulated exterior recovery/atmosphere sources. Keep legacy whole-domain drift separate; no pointwise accuracy requirement inside masks. A last-stage recovery field is not a time-integrated source.

remnant_mass_relative_uncertainty.meaning: Three matched resolutions and positive observed order; finest Richardson mass error <=1%.

remnant_mass_tail_relative_range.meaning: Common late-time horizon-mass window; residual accretion must be resolved or reported.

remnant_dimensionless_spin_abs_max.meaning: Nonrotating initial data: abs(J_AH)/M_Christodoulou^2, not the dimensional spin field.

collapse_detection_relative_uncertainty.meaning: Resolution plus first-reliable-AH detection cadence uncertainty; same gauge and units. Not an exact universal collapse time.

exterior_constraint_observed_order.meaning: Matched common exterior region, three resolutions; first-order shock-limited convergence allowed. No fourth-order assumption.

initial_ADM_mass_relative_error.meaning: Constraint-solved pair actual ADM mass, not twice the isolated seed mass.

pre_AH_baryon_relative_drift.meaning: Existing BNS protocol minimum; full pre-AH prefix including any restart joins required.

waveform_relative_uncertainty.meaning: Three-resolution dominant l2,m0 complex waveform uncertainty for this head-on-from-rest model.

extraction_radius_relative_spread.meaning: Same retarded-time signal after finite-radius/extrapolation analysis; not raw coordinate-time differences.

post_AH_baryon_balance_verified.meaning: Explain the reported post-AH drift and close a defined physical-exterior baryon budget with moving inner-boundary flux, outer flux and accumulated exterior recovery/atmosphere sources. Keep legacy whole-domain drift separate; no pointwise accuracy requirement inside masks. A last-stage recovery field is not a time-integrated source.

reference_setup_verified.meaning: Actual matched AthenaK/PANGU initial data and normalizations; a similar scenario is insufficient.

reference_target_completed.meaning: Both matched trajectories cover the declared comparison interval, including validated restart joins.

reference_waveform_relative_L2.meaning: Dominant complex M*r*Psi4 at common retarded times with fixed, documented tetrad/sign conventions.

reference_peak_time_difference_M.meaning: Peak retarded-time difference in units of actual initial total ADM mass; no unrestricted fit.

extraction_radius_relative_spread.meaning: Three extraction radii, common retarded interval, controlled finite-radius error.

waveform_phase_additional_requirement.scope: Report phase only where amplitude >1% peak; real head-on signals use a declared nonzero quadrupole mode with complex L2 and peak time instead. Current x-axis BBH uses m2; z-axis BNS uses m0. Use continuously unwrapped phases; wrapped-angle previews are not physical phase gates.

parent_protocol.reason: User-supplied review requires explicit convergence and direct mature-code comparisons in addition to numerical budgets.
